entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • WinUI TabbedPage can have multiple tabs selected #31799
  • [Android] When setting a ControlTemplate, the resulting view doesn't size itself properly #31797
  • Default MAUI project template doesn't compile. "Xaml Internal Error error WMC9999: Name cannot begin with the '<' character, hexadecimal value 0x3C." #31794
  • Blazor Hybrid Web template fails to work on WASM with .NET 10 RC1" #31785
  • [Android] Unexpected Line Breaks in Android, Label with WordWrap Mode Due to Trailing Space. #31782
  • The RealParent on Microsoft.Maui.Controls.Shapes.RoundRectangle has been Garbage Collected #31780

Closed

  • Parameter passing in shell apps doesn't work in release mode ( android & windows ) #10771
  • RemainingItemsThresholdReached on CollectionView is triggered infinitely when a ControlTemplate is set #23370
  • Tapping with two fingers at the same time crashes the app #31285
  • [Blazor][Maui][HotReload][XML][VS 2022] #31633
